headline: John Legend says he doesn’t see himself performing with Ye again, and shrugs off past comm
body: John Legend says he doesn’t see himself performing with Ye again, and shrugs off past comments Ye has made about him. “I don’t see myself performing with him, but I’m happy to talk to him and, like, just connect on a human level. We haven’t done that in years. ” : Bootleg Kev/YouTube.
